mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 46 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park. The air quality index is at a moderate 77, and we are under a waxing gibbous moon. The International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 5:45 AM, rising in the west near Mount Horeb and passing halfway up the sky toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot.

The City of Verona is moving forward with Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction. Crews have finished underground utility work and are currently wrapping up gravel base and concrete installations on the east block and Scheel Court. Also, remember that the city offers a toilet rebate program and an Eye-On-Water monitoring tool to help manage your utility usage.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Bogey Factory, or Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to ART House 360 events and trivia at Hop Haus. Later this week, we also have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market on Friday.

Regarding the weekly report, the Verona Police Department responded to an incident on Wednesday, October 15, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating the incident.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. If you are planning a visit, please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
